Table: agent_personal_workspace_execution
`id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
`execution_id` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
`owner_jiacn` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
`task_id` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
`run_id` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
`execution_mode` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
`execution_state` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
`permitted_operation` varchar(40) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin DEFAULT NULL,
`controlled_consent_id` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin DEFAULT NULL,
`output_content_mime_type` varchar(127) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
`conversation_lease_version` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
`conversation_provider_started_at` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
`conversation_provider_lease_version` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
`tenant_id` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
`client_id` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
`update_time` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
`execution_protocol_version` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
`operation_grant_id` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin DEFAULT NULL,
`runtime_input_snapshot_digest` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
UNIQUE KEY `uk_pwex_fixture_execution` (`tenant_id`,`client_id`,`owner_jiacn`,`execution_id`),
UNIQUE KEY `uk_pwex_fixture_run` (`tenant_id`,`client_id`,`owner_jiacn`,`task_id`,`run_id`),
UNIQUE KEY `uk_pwex_controlled_consent` (`tenant_id`,`client_id`,`owner_jiacn`,`controlled_consent_id`),
UNIQUE KEY `uk_pwex_operation_grant` (`tenant_id`,`client_id`,`owner_jiacn`,`operation_grant_id`),

CONSTRAINT `chk_pwex_controlled_consent` CHECK (((`controlled_consent_id` is null) or ((`execution_mode` = _utf8mb4'CONVERSATION') and regexp_like(`controlled_consent_id`,cast(_utf8mb4'^consent_[0-9a-f]{32}$' as char charset binary)) and (((`execution_protocol_version` = 2) and (`permitted_operation` = _utf8mb4'GENERATE_IMAGE') and (`operation_grant_id` is null) and (`runtime_input_snapshot_digest` is null)) or ((`execution_protocol_version` = 3) and (`permitted_operation` in (_utf8mb4'GENERATE_IMAGE',_utf8mb4'EDIT_IMAGE')) and regexp_like(`operation_grant_id`,cast(_utf8mb4'^opgrant_[0-9a-f]{32}$' as char charset binary)) and regexp_like(`runtime_input_snapshot_digest`,cast(_utf8mb4'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' as char charset binary)))) and (`output_content_mime_type` = _utf8mb4'image/png')))),

CONSTRAINT `chk_pwex_execution_protocol` CHECK ((((`execution_protocol_version` = 1) and (`controlled_consent_id` is null) and (`operation_grant_id` is null) and (`runtime_input_snapshot_digest` is null)) or ((`execution_protocol_version` = 2) and regexp_like(`controlled_consent_id`,cast(_utf8mb4'^consent_[0-9a-f]{32}$' as char charset binary)) and (`operation_grant_id` is null) and (`runtime_input_snapshot_digest` is null)) or ((`execution_protocol_version` = 3) and (`execution_mode` = _utf8mb4'CONVERSATION') and regexp_like(`controlled_consent_id`,cast(_utf8mb4'^consent_[0-9a-f]{32}$' as char charset binary)) and regexp_like(`operation_grant_id`,cast(_utf8mb4'^opgrant_[0-9a-f]{32}$' as char charset binary)) and regexp_like(`runtime_input_snapshot_digest`,cast(_utf8mb4'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' as char charset binary)) and (`permitted_operation` in (_utf8mb4'GENERATE_IMAGE',_utf8mb4'EDIT_IMAGE')) and (`output_content_mime_type` = _utf8mb4'image/png'))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin
